description: Generate an Express (TypeScript) webhook receiver for Tiendanube / Nuvemshop: x-linkedstore-hmac-sha256 verification over the raw body, immediate 200, one case per event and a node:test for the signature. Returns the files for the caller to write; the server never writes to disk.

dir.description: Folder for the generated files, relative to the project root (default "src")

events.description: Events to handle, as in lookup-webhook-event (e.g. ["order/paid", "app/uninstalled"])

name: scaffold-webhook-handler

files.description: Files to write. The server never writes to disk.

path.description: Path relative to the project root

title: Scaffold a webhook receiver
